commit_message: Add ADR 0110 Humanoid imported asset contract
pr_title: Implement ADR 0110 humanoid profiles and motion
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 in staged dispatcher requests. This stage adds the HumanoidMotion imported-sub-asset category, derives each portable variant from its Native clip stable ID, and extends manifest stable-ID validation for both model-owned and target-model-specific motion sources. Earlier stages added model-owned HumanoidProfile persistence/validation and portable model-space motion bake/cache.
